text: The bazaar opens with no departures and the graveyard empty. The roster stands: Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock. No plague touched the night. I ask Morpheus plainly: did your watch see any lights left burning past the Doctor's protection?

The bazaar opens with no departures and the graveyard empty. The roster stands: Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock all remain. I ask Morpheus plainly: did your watch see any lights left burning past the Doctor's protection?

Inigo, Hermione asked you plainly: did you see or hear anything overnight that the Herald missed? The bazaar’s ledger shows no answer, only the same silence others fill with their own questions. Elsa, six of us asked if any lantern in the eastern lane stayed low—you answered only that the bazaar opened whole. That silence is not a fact; it is a ledger gap. I ask Elsa again: did even one lantern in the eastern lane flicker low when the shutters rose? The Doctor’s mark would show there first.
